The '''Algarian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algarian]].
